title: Dawa.ug
subtitle: Mobile-first marketplace experience for Uganda
description: A responsive marketplace interface for buying, selling, and discovering products in Uganda. The frontend brings listings, search, wishlists, buyer-seller conversations, and trust signals together in a flow designed for mobile-first users.
problem: The marketplace needed to feel simple and trustworthy on the devices and connections many Ugandan users rely on. Buyers had to scan listings quickly, while sellers needed a low-friction path from posting to conversation.
role: Focused on the frontend implementation: responsive listing and search views, product detail pages, user-facing profile and wishlist flows, messaging interfaces, and mobile interaction patterns.
approach: Built the interface with React and Next.js, prioritizing server-rendered product content, clear information hierarchy, responsive layouts, and lightweight interactions for mobile users. The UI makes verification, safety guidance, and seller communication visible without adding friction.
hardestDecision: Building trust features: safety tips, secure meeting location suggestions, and verification systems without adding friction that would discourage adoption in a market where simplicity drives usage.
outcome: Live at dawa.ug as a frontend experience for a trusted Ugandan marketplace, covering product discovery, listing presentation, account surfaces, messaging, and safety-oriented interaction patterns.
whatIdChange: Would integrate mobile money payment escrow, add location-based search for local pickups, and implement a rating/review system for buyer-seller trust.
